_instructions: Source of truth for the build. DO NOT delete, edit, or renumber existing ids/titles. Statuses: passing (done+proven), failing (actionable), deferred (postponed; notes say when actionable), superseded (dead, kept for history). Flip failing->passing only when a test or the stated manual check proves it. Append new features with the next id in their milestone. Work ONE feature per session: lowest milestone, then lowest id, among 'failing'.

milestones.51: Upgrade re-checks open plans; board shows every field
milestones.52: Onboarding installs what its docs reference
milestones.55: GitHub issues as the place to write features

features.title: Release README coverage: every CHANGELOG release from 3.17.0 names the README phrases that document it (or README: none (reason)), checked by scripts/check-readme.sh in the gate; HARNESS_TEMPLATE_DIR runs the template sync check
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-check-readme.sh proving a covered release passes, and a missing README: line, a line without phrases, none without a reason, a phrase absent from README.md and 3.17.10 (numeric compare) all fail; this repo's CHANGELOG/README pass; bash scripts/ci-local.sh prints CI-LOCAL GREEN

features.title: Upgrade re-checks open plans against the current protocol: upgrade.sh names each failing feature missing depends_on or paths, and a chain where each open feature depends only on the previous one as 'depends_on may be order only'; the upgrade skill proposes fixes for approval
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-upgrade.sh proving the lanes TODO names the open feature without paths, the order-only TODO names the chain, and a passing feature is never named

features.title: Board rows show every FEATURES.json field ('All fields', open state kept across reloads) and a queued row's agent column shows its planned model and effort; a deferred feature shows 'deferred', not 'queued'
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-board.sh proving a row lists exclusive, evaluate, bar, depends_on, paths and an escaped verify under All fields, and a queued row shows 'model large · effort high', and a deferred feature's row has stage deferred

features.title: Run state is never committed: setup, upgrade and the template mirror sync add .harness-run/ to .gitignore (the runs protocol already claimed it was listed), quiet.sh ignores its own log folder in a repo that lacks the entry, and the audit warns when .harness-run/ is not ignored
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-upgrade.sh proving upgrade.sh adds .harness-run/ once (CHANGED, then OK) and keeps a last .gitignore line without a newline whole, test-session.sh proving quiet.sh leaves git status clean in a repo without the entry and writes no .gitignore where the repo ignores it, and test-audit.sh proving the WARN, and test-sync-template.sh proving the mirror's .gitignore gets .harness-run/ appended with its own entries kept

features.title: Onboarded docs name only files that exist where they say: kit scripts and templates (quiet.sh, context.sh, run-gate.sh, feature.sh, status.sh, *.tmpl) are called kit files with their kit location and a plugin-less fallback, and scripts/check-doc-refs.sh fails the gate when a protocol doc or AGENTS.md.tmpl names a file neither installed by setup nor shipped by the kit, or names kit files without saying so
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-check-doc-refs.sh proving the kit is clean and each of: an unknown script, a kit script or template without the location note, an uninstalled scripts/*.sh (unless called optional), and a .gitignore claim without setup or upgrade adding .harness-run/ makes check-doc-refs.sh exit 1

features.title: Acceptance checks: a checks list per feature and one reader (read-checks.sh) with FEATURES.json, markdown and GitHub issue backends that print the same normalized lines
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-checks.sh proving each check below

checks.title: FEATURES.json backend prints one line per check
steps: Run read-checks.sh on a fixture FEATURES.json with two features carrying three checks
checks.pass_if: Three JSON lines, each with feature, id, title, critical, steps, pass_if and evidence equal to the fixture values; exit 0

checks.title: Issue backend matches the FEATURES.json backend
steps: Run read-checks.sh --issue-json on a gh issue view fixture whose body holds the same checks in markdown
Compare with the FEATURES.json backend output for that feature
checks.pass_if: The two outputs are byte-identical and the feature id comes from the [ID] issue title prefix

checks.title: Malformed checks are named and rejected
steps: Run the reader on fixtures with a wrong id prefix, empty steps, an unknown evidence, a non-boolean critical and a duplicate id
checks.pass_if: Exit 1 and stderr names the check id and the broken field for each case

features.title: harness-brief writes checks: brief template gains a Checks section; check-brief.sh fails a brief without checks, with a malformed check or a vague Pass if; the brief reviewer treats missing or vague checks as BLOCKING
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-brief.sh and test-checks.sh proving each check below

checks.title: A brief without checks fails
steps: Run check-brief.sh on a brief with no Checks section
Run it on a brief whose Checks section has no ### check
checks.pass_if: Both exit non-zero with a FAIL line naming Checks

checks.title: A vague Pass if fails
steps: Run check-brief.sh on a brief whose check says Pass if: it works correctly
checks.pass_if: Exit non-zero with a FAIL line naming the check id and the vague word

checks.title: The reviewer blocks missing or vague checks
steps: Read agents/src/harness-brief-reviewer.md and the generated reviewer agents
checks.pass_if: The BLOCKING list names a deliverable with no check and a Pass if a stranger could not judge

features.title: harness-builder writes one test per check, before the code, titled with the check id and tagged @critical when the check is critical
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-checks.sh proving the check below

checks.title: Builder instructions require one test per check
steps: Read agents/src/harness-builder.md and every generated builder agent
checks.pass_if: Each says one test per check, written before the code, title starting with the check id, @critical when critical

features.title: check-coverage.sh: every check of a passing or review feature has exactly one test with an agreeing @critical tag, and no test names an unknown check; setup installs it with the reader and e2e.sh.tmpl runs it; this repo's gate runs it over its check tests (scripts/test-checks.sh)
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-checks.sh proving each check below and check-coverage.sh green on this repo; bash scripts/ci-local.sh prints CI-LOCAL GREEN

checks.title: Full coverage passes
steps: Run check-coverage.sh on a fixture repo whose passing feature has two checks, one critical, each with one matching test
checks.pass_if: Exit 0 and a line saying 2 checks covered

checks.title: Each coverage gap fails with its own message
steps: Run it on fixtures with a missing test, two tests for one id, a test naming an unknown id, and a critical check without @critical
checks.pass_if: Exit 1 for each, stderr naming the id and the gap; a failing feature's missing test does not fail

checks.title: Repos get the coverage step
steps: Read e2e.sh.tmpl and harness-initial-setup SKILL.md
checks.pass_if: The template runs scripts/check-coverage.sh and setup copies check-coverage.sh and read-checks.sh into scripts/

features.title: harness-evaluator writes one row per check (covered, partial, missing, unrequested) and acceptance-verdict.sh turns the table into PASS or NEEDS_WORK; the script decides, not the model
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-checks.sh proving each check below

checks.title: All covered is PASS
steps: Run acceptance-verdict.sh on a feature with two checks and a table marking both covered
checks.pass_if: Prints PASS and exits 0

checks.title: Anything else is NEEDS_WORK
steps: Run it with a partial row, a missing row, an unrequested row, a check with no row, two rows for one check and an unknown verdict word
checks.pass_if: Each prints NEEDS_WORK with the reason and exits 1

checks.title: The evaluator uses the script
steps: Read agents/src/harness-evaluator.md and the generated evaluator agents
checks.pass_if: They require the per-check table and say the verdict is acceptance-verdict.sh's output

features.title: The run board marks a run that died without run-end as stalled: with no run-end and no on-disk activity (events.log, results, quiet.sh logs in the main repo and lanes) for HARNESS_BOARD_STALE seconds (default 1800), building and gate-running rows show stalled, the header says run stalled with the idle time, and the Stop button is replaced by no live run
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-board.sh proving: a dispatched feature whose latest activity is 2h old shows stalled and the header says run stalled with no Stop button; touching a quiet.sh log makes it building again; HARNESS_BOARD_STALE raises the threshold; a run with run-end says run ended, not stalled

features.title: issues.sh sync pulls GitHub issues into FEATURES.json: the issue owns title and checks, the repo owns everything else; new [id] issues become failing features; broken issues are reported and skipped
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-issues.sh proving each check below against a fake gh

checks.title: Sync pulls titles and checks, keeps repo fields
steps: Fake gh serves an issue for an existing feature with a new title and checks, and an issue for an id not in FEATURES.json
Run issues.sh sync
checks.pass_if: The existing feature has the issue's title and checks with status, paths and verify unchanged; the new id is a failing feature in its M<n> milestone with its checks

checks.title: A broken issue is reported and skipped
steps: Add an issue whose check has no Steps
Run issues.sh sync
checks.pass_if: Exit 1, stderr names the issue number and the check problem, and the other issues still sync

checks.title: A features repo is left alone
steps: Run issues.sh sync on a FEATURES.json without source issues
checks.pass_if: Exit 0, a line saying source is features, and gh is never called

features.title: issues.sh sync pushes the repo's view back: a generated details block (status, Done when, depends on, paths, model and effort, notes, Needs a human, plan section) between markers, a harness:<status> label, close on passing; idempotent
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-issues.sh proving each check below

checks.title: Details block written, owner text untouched, second run silent
steps: Run issues.sh sync on an issue whose feature has verify, paths, depends_on, model, effort, notes and a plan section
Run it again
checks.pass_if: The body is the owner's text unchanged, then one marked block holding every listed field and the plan section; the second run makes no gh write call

checks.title: Status shows as a label and closes passing issues
steps: Sync a passing feature whose issue is open and a failing one whose issue is closed
checks.pass_if: The passing issue is closed with label harness:passing; the failing one is reopened with harness:failing and no other harness: label

features.title: issues.sh migrate moves only open work to GitHub issues (failing and deferred, ids kept, checks as markdown, GitHub milestones) and switches the repo to source issues; history stays in git; idempotent, --dry-run writes nothing
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-issues.sh proving each check below

checks.title: Migrate creates issues for open features only
steps: Run issues.sh migrate on a FEATURES.json with passing, superseded, failing and deferred features
checks.pass_if: One issue per failing and deferred feature titled [id] title in milestone M<n> <name>, whose checks read back through read-checks.sh identical to FEATURES.json; no issue for the others; source is issues; archive and PROGRESS.md unchanged

checks.title: Migrate is safe to re-run and to preview
steps: Run issues.sh migrate --dry-run on a fresh repo
Run issues.sh migrate twice
checks.pass_if: The dry run prints the issues it would create and makes no gh write call; the second real run creates nothing
